policy: Prefer newest supported stable LTS toolchains. Keep Python 3.14 and PostgreSQL 17 by explicit architecture decision, Java 21 for subscriptions, Node 26 LTS, pnpm 12; exceptions require owner evidence and recorded limitations, not silent fallback.

python.gate: rebuild both image architectures; uv/Poetry frozen installs; Python owner tests

node.gate: libatomic and engine constraints; all Next.js/Medusa owner builds and tests

pnpm.gate: regenerate/validate frozen lockfile, private GHCR packages, all web E2E

java.gate: Subscriptions Maven Java 21 build and compatibility; ERP Java owner compatibility

postgresql.gate: PostgreSQL 17 local fresh DB and migration separation under DEV-12

playwright.gate: browser binary vs @playwright/test equality; actual native E2E/visual/lighthouse

corepack.gate: install as separate pinned package on Node 26 (not bundled); verify signature integrity and noninteractive frozen pnpm

required_qualification: provider lock and exact source convergence
both AMD64 and ARM64 image scans and signed image evidence
clean native-user Codespace plus current-user private GHCR/npm reads
affected consumers including Medusa Java Rust and three digital estates
no browser binary skew across Playwright consumer versions
rollback of tool pins image digest private packages and independently owned PG17 data
exceptions: Only bounded and evidenced owner-specific compatibility exceptions; no production blanket scan exemption or unsafe fallback
note: This file is a reviewed uplift target registry, not an installed-version declaration or CI PASS receipt. R4 conducts candidate upgrades after R1 source reconciliation.
